what: Rung marker never leaves the proton rung (markerL peak 14.77). Through 'Electrons are so small' (f859-1008), 'the Planck length' (f1062-1106) and the 34-zero readout, the glowing marker sits at 10^-15 while the narration names ELECTRON and PLANCK LENGTH lower down.
evidence: Frames 859, 1062, 1110, 1132, 1271: the glow stays at the PROTON chip; props ladder.markerL peak 14.77 (proton). Lesson 33: the marker sits at the rung being named.
suggested_fix: Glide the marker to the electron bracket at ~f859 (or show it as an open/empty marker for 'no size found') and to the Planck line at planckIn f1074; keep it there through the readout.

what: The YOUR EYE / ~0.1 mm label sits on top of the axis numbers: '~0.1 mm' overlaps the 10^-4 'm' and the 10^-5 tick label disappears behind it for the rest of the film.
evidence: Crop of f199 and all later frames: the axis reads 10^-3, [YOUR EYE ~0.1 mm], 10^-6. LIGHT MICROSCOPE (f489+) likewise replaces the 10^-7 label.
suggested_fix: Fade the axis numbers the reference labels cover, or move the reference labels left of the numbers / onto the dashed lines' far side.

what: The 34-zero readout box sits beside the RED BLOOD CELL / VIRUS rows, and their dashed reference leaders run into its left edge, so at a glance it reads as a virus annotation instead of the Planck value 30 rungs below.
evidence: Frames 1240-1455 at 360x640: the box spans the y range of the RBC and VIRUS chips; the dashed lines end ~3 px from its border.
suggested_fix: Put the readout near the Planck line (right side, around the electron/Planck rows) or connect it to the Planck label with a thin leader.

what: An empty readout box shows for about 7 frames (alpha starts f1200, first digit f1207) and reads as a blank, broken card at the start of s5.
evidence: f1204/f1205: an empty dark rounded rectangle at the upper right.
suggested_fix: Start readout.alpha at 1207 together with the first '0', or fade the box in with the first digit.

what: Crowding on the bottom of the ladder: the PLANCK LENGTH label is about 20 px (full res) above placard 4, and the -35 superscript of the placard's second line touches the 'found,' line above. At 360x640 the label, the placard and the 'a floor? unproven' note merge into one block.
suggested_fix: Add ~12 px of leading between the placard lines and ~20 px more gap under the Planck label, or move placard 4 down.

what: Caption onsets: all 14 spot-checked words fall within +-2 f, but four sweep-placed words sit at the early edge: 'Maybe' lights ~2.0-2.5 f before the /m/ voicing (f1305), 'after' ~1.9 f early (vowel f1245), s4 'that' ~1.4-1.9 f early (f912-913), and s1 'sand' ~2 f late (the /s/ noise starts ~f27). The others measured within ~1 f: hair 0, cell 0, found 0, to 0..+1, zeros ~0 (masked by the spin tick), the(1st) +0.7, the(2nd) -0.4, isn't ~0..+1.6 (/z/ noise at +1.6). blood and 'that,' can't be resolved because the voicing band is under the bed.
evidence: 5 ms band-energy profiles on the master audio (voicing 100-1000 Hz, mid 1-3 kHz, fricative 3-9 kHz) compared with props captionPages f0.
suggested_fix: Optional: move 'Maybe' to 1305 and 'after' to 1245. Nothing is outside tolerance by more than ~0.5 f.

what: Taste: the bottom ~30% of the frame is empty for the whole film, and the right column is empty from the window close (f845) to the readout (f1207), so s4 has nothing to look at on the right while the electron and Planck beats play at the bottom-left of the rail.
suggested_fix: Optional: a small drawn electron 'point' card in the window during s4, or extend the rail lower so the s4 beats are not crammed at its foot.
